This '''[[Clone medical officer/Legends|clone medical officer]]''' was stationed on [[Ord Cestus medical station/Legends|medical station]] near [[Ord Cestus/Legends|Ord Cestus]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], this clone medical officer was stationed at the Ord Cestus medical station in the aftermath of the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Second Battle of Geonosis]]. [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] were tasked in bringing [[Supply ship/Legends|supply ship]] [[TB-73/Legends|''TB-73'']] to the station in order to retrieve medical supplies for [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu's]] forces on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. A clone named [[Scythe (clone trooper)/Legends|Scythe]] brought dozens of [[Brain worm/Legends|brain worm]] eggs into the [[Pelta-class frigate/Legends|''Pelta''-class frigate]] and infected the crew, taking control of the ship.<ref name="Brain Invaders" />

This clone was in the operations center of the station alongside [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] and [[Nala Se/Legends|Nala Se]] as Tano managed to gain control of this ship and the frigate was safely docked at the center with the aide of [[Republic tugboat/Legends|interstellar tugs]].<ref name="Brain Invaders" />
